description: This is a shell script that functions as a watchdog for monitoring Beerocks processes, handling errors, and ensuring process health. It includes process management, error handling, logging, and process monitoring logic.

methods.name: killall_program
methods.description: Kills all processes matching a given program name, optionally with a specific signal.

methods.name: is_program_running
methods.description: Checks if a program with the specified name is currently running.
